pages.title: A10 · Gold layer views and tables
lede: Objective (S3): build and choose gold objects (materialized views, views, streaming tables, and tables, e.g. CREATE TABLE AS SELECT (CTAS)) for business intelligence (BI) and analytics teams in Unity Catalog.
silver.customers 101-104 (state = region: TX, TX, CO, OK) + silver.orders 5001-5005 (latest row per order, end of Nov 3).

blocks.heading: 1. The four gold objects
blocks.code:
View               no data   recomputed on every query     ad-hoc slices
Materialized view  stored    recomputed on each refresh    aggregates, joins, changes
Streaming table    stored    each new input row once       append-only ingestion
Table (CTAS)       stored    only when you write to it     frozen snapshots
blocks.note: Materialized views and streaming tables are Unity Catalog managed tables, backed by a pipeline.

blocks.heading: 2. The gold query (local run, Nov 3 data)
blocks.code:
SELECT o.order_date, c.state AS region, COUNT(*) AS order_count, SUM(o.amount) AS total_sales
FROM silver.orders o JOIN silver.customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
GROUP BY o.order_date, c.state;
-- 2026-11-02 TX 2 58.50 | 2026-11-03 CO 1 13.50 | 2026-11-03 OK 1 18.00 | 2026-11-03 TX 1 40.00
blocks.note: Nov 4: order 5002 (a Nov 2 order) updated 30.00 -> 36.00. Correct Nov 2 TX = 28.50 + 36.00 = 64.50.

blocks.heading: 3. Materialized view for the dashboard
blocks.note: Current as of its last refresh: manual, SCHEDULE EVERY / CRON, or TRIGGER ON UPDATE.

blocks.heading: 4. After the late update (Nov 2 TX)
blocks.code:
view gold.daily_sales_v              64.50   recomputed on read (local run)
CTAS gold.daily_sales_snapshot       58.50   stored once, never rewritten (local run)
materialized view, before refresh    58.50   expected
materialized view, after refresh     64.50   expected
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW gold.orders_by_region ...   ad-hoc slices, no storage

pages.title: The trap, checklist, snippet

blocks.heading: 5. The trap: a streaming table for the daily aggregate
blocks.text: A streaming table processes each input row once and expects an append-only source. A streaming read of a Delta table throws an error on UPDATE, DELETE, MERGE INTO or overwrite; with skipChangeCommits the change is skipped, not applied. Nov 2 TX stays wrong until a full refresh. Use a materialized view when the query aggregates or joins, or when the source can change. Memory trick: streaming tables read each row once. Materialized views recompute the answer.

blocks.heading: 6. Object-choice checklist
blocks.text: 1) Latency: must every read be fully current? (view always; materialized view as of last refresh; streaming table low latency for new rows) 2) Refresh: who updates it? (none / manual, schedule, on update / each pipeline update / only when you write) 3) Late data: can old rows change? Aggregate or join: materialized view. 4) Cost: view pays every read; materialized view pays at refresh, reads cheap. Free Edition: one active pipeline per pipeline type.

blocks.heading: 7. Reusable snippet: one of each
blocks.note: Rule of thumb: streaming tables for bronze ingestion, materialized views for gold aggregates, views for ad-hoc slices, tables for frozen snapshots.

blocks.heading: Practice challenge
blocks.text: Q1 TX SUM(amount) in gold.orders_by_region after the update: 104.50 (28.50 + 36.00 + 40.00). Q2 November totals frozen at month-end: a table (CREATE TABLE AS SELECT). Q3 insert 5006 (104, Nov 4, 25.00) + refresh: 5 rows, new Nov 4 OK 1 25.00, Nov 2 TX still 64.50. Exam-style (append-only JSON files, each once, low latency): a streaming table with STREAM read_files.
